verdict.rationale: LightSprint offers background cloud agents that work without a local session, and tasks can be triggered from Slack, Linear or Jira. That gives some unattended automation, but nothing shows the product itself being invoked headlessly or from a CI pipeline. Its GitHub Actions compatibility concerns PR delivery, not running LightSprint in CI, and probes found no public OpenAPI spec. Missing for 10: a documented CLI or headless invocation mode, a public API for triggering runs programmatically, CI integration (e.g. a GitHub Action that runs LightSprint), and independent or hands-on corroboration.
